svg.title: High-energy emission from seven magnetar giant flare candidates
svg.desc: Fermi-LAT energy flux from 0.1 to 10 GeV during the first 1,000 seconds. In units of 10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹, GRB 200415A has measured flux 4.14 ± 2.33 (one standard deviation). The 95% upper limits are 2.75 for GRB 081213A, 0.85 for 180128A, 1.99 for 200423A, 1.29 for 231024A, and 1.05 for 231115A. GRB 120616A had no exposure in this window. Source: Chand et al. 2026, arXiv:2608.06527, Table 2.
